title: ProfileFile
description: A reading-profile file (card R-1): the public profile/seeds.json, and the private overlay <data root>/private/profile-overlay.json. Same shape; what each may hold is policy, enforced in code (src/recommend/profile.ts: assertPublishable for the seeds, mergeOverlay for the overlay) and, for the seeds, by the privacy guard (INV-19). Entries are what the owner has said of authors, works, series and tags; nodes are taste in terms of the vocabulary (taste-model.md §2.3). Read, liked and inferred stay separate (INV-18).

Id.description: Unique within the file; seeds and overlay never share one.

Origin.description: Where a claim came from. `source` is an allow-list: owner-statement, owner-correction and owner-preference may be public; taste-tree, chatgpt-export and selfco are private, always (OC9, INV-19).

ref.description: A short human-readable citation, never a path to private data.

id.description: The catalog's id for a work (`isfdb:<title_id>`); absent for an author named in a seed.

scope.description: `all-works`: the statement covers every work of the author or series. `one-work`: one work.

expanded.description: Generated from a compact seed against the catalog. Never written to profile/seeds.json. `expandedFrom` is the id of the seed it came from.

Support.description: What a node rests on: a seed's id, or an event the owner asserted. Nothing else may back a node (DERIVED catalog evidence and SYNTH output can inform a hypothesis but never support one).

TermNode.description: One taste-tree node: a term on a facet, pulled toward or pushed away from.

evidence.description: ASSERTED: the owner stated it. SYNTH: a model proposed it; accepting it sets `status` to asserted but never turns it into ASSERTED, and it stays private.

OpenQuestion.description: A reader-side unknown ('What cools Neal Stephenson for you?'); `about` is the id of the seed it asks about. It carries no weight until the owner answers it (taste-model.md §9).
